scoring_justification: Validation errors compared to paper values with threshold_or_better; clustering trends are structural audit because exact stress magnitudes are not given and only trend ordering is verifiable.

outputs.description: Validation error metrics: maximum and average relative error of von Mises stress compared to the conventional SAM reference.
Per‑replicate stress metrics for each cluster volume fraction and material type, used to verify monotonic trends with cluster concentration.

output_contract.notes: The clustering_results.csv must contain data for both stiff (E_I/E_M=4) and compliant (E_I/E_M=0.5) cases, with 10 replicates each at Vf_U=100%, 50%, 25%. The trends are verified by computing means from the per‑replicate data.

hidden_assets.purpose: reference error values from paper Table 2 (row 1)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 2, first row: stiff inclusions, cluster at (0,0,0.48a0), 0.02a0 size, max error 3.95%, avg error 0.98%
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the reported values in the paper; they serve as reference for validation check.

checks.description: Max von Mises error must be <= reference + tolerance for full credit; partial credit linearly decreases to 0 at upper_bound
Avg von Mises error must be <= reference + tolerance for full credit; partial credit linearly decreases to 0 at upper_bound

steps.description: Verify monotonic trends of means across Vf_U 100% -> 50% -> 25% per material type.
